sources.entry: Boostnote - Note-taking application made for programmers just like you.

summary.one_liner: BoostNote-Legacy is the legacy Electron-based desktop note-taking app for programmers, available for Mac, Windows and Linux.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Boostnote as a note-taking application for programmers, with desktop builds for Mac, Windows and Linux. It is built with Electron, React + Redux, Webpack, and CSS Modules. The README links to a releases page for the latest downloads and to a development configuration section for building from source. A banner at the top says a new Boost Note app with real-time collaborative writing has been launched and is open source, and it points users to download links for web, desktop and mobile versions of that newer app. This repository is the older codebase, with copyright noted as 2016 to 2020 by BoostIO, Inc. The README gives no detailed feature list beyond the note-taking purpose.
use_cases: keep code snippets and notes on desktop
run a note-taking app on Mac, Windows or Linux
study or modify an Electron note app codebase
how_to_run: Find the latest release of Boostnote on the repository's releases page and download it
For development, see the development configurations referenced in the README
notable: Desktop note-taking app built specifically for programmers
Cross-platform: Mac, Windows and Linux via Electron
Legacy codebase; the README points to a newer open-source Boost Note app with real-time collaboration
Includes development configuration for building from source
caveats: Legacy codebase; the README points users to a newer Boost Note app instead
README gives no detailed setup steps for building from source
